ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low macro-level ratio; approximately 95% of the visible surface consists of low-intensity black pixels (RGB values near 0,0,0) with high-intensity white pixel clusters (RGB values near 255,255,255) accounting for less than 5% of the surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant homogeneous black field across both lobes. High-contrast white geometric blobs are concentrated at the extreme lateral tips (distal edges). acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive textured pixel clusters at the distal tips indicating significant barnacle colonization; widespread circular attachment scars (healed rosettes) distributed across the entire dark surface of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique and dense distribution of distinct white ring-shaped markings against the uniform low-intensity background across the entire fluke surface.
